notes.title: The Wayfarers story: weaving what was and what is into a new adventure
notes.notes:
Writing the story of Wayfarers was a joint effort. What was already in place and what was added on top of the existing structure?

The first developer article about Call of Osiris just went live on IndieDB. Make sure to check it out if you're interested in how the Wayfarers story took shape! 

[url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/wayfarers-call-of-osiris/news/the-wayfarers-story-weaving-what-was-and-what-is-into-a-new-adventure]Article: The Wayfarers story: weaving what was and what is into a new adventure[/url]

notes.title: Kickstarter campaign coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39808366/81acec2350624a822ed68b1f1d8e9a083cd11616.jpg[/img]

Our Kickstarter campaign kicks off next week – we'll post an announcement when it goes live. You can already visit its campaign page at https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/actalogic/wayfarers-call-of-osiris
and click on ‘Notify me on launch’.
We’d also appreciate if you wishlisted us on Steam or joined our mailing list on https://www.callofosiris.com
